verdict.rationale: Browserbase is a browser-agent platform with its own hosted Agents, so letting users plug in external MCP servers as tools is a fair question for it. The pack only documents Browserbase's own official MCP server (probe-3), which is the server role and does not show its agents consuming third-party MCP servers. No evidence shows Browserbase acting as an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
